aviation_incidents.headline: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29戰機墜毀 飛行員罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 塞爾維亞國防部表示，該國空軍與防空部隊一架MiG-29戰鬥機於2026年11月17日在貝爾格勒西北方的Stara Pazova附近墜毀，飛行員Goran Bulajić少校罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes, killing pilot
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Serbia’s Ministry of Defense said a Serbian Air Force and Air Defense MiG-29 fighter crashed on November 17, 2026, near Stara Pazova, northwest of Belgrade, killing its pilot, Major Goran Bulajić.
entities: Serbian Air Force and Air Defense

aviation_incidents.headline: 俄軍安-12運輸機西伯利亞墜機、機上19人全數罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 俄羅斯一架安東諾夫安-12軍用運輸機於2026年11月17日墜毀在西伯利亞西南部克麥羅沃州，俄羅斯國防部表示機上19人全數罹難。國防部表示，該機當時正在執行定期飛行任務，墜落在無人居住地區，初步研判技術故障造成這起墜機事故，調查正在進行。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Russian An-12 military transport aircraft crashes in Siberia, all 19 on board killed
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in the Kemerovo region of southwestern Siberia on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, killing all 19 people on board, Russia's Defence Ministry said. The ministry said the aircraft was on a scheduled flight when it came down in an uninhabited area, and that preliminary findings indicate a technical malfunction caused the crash. An investigation is underway.

aviation_incidents.headline: 英國航空787-10客機滑出滑行道受困草地、拉各斯航班取消
aviation_incidents.summary: 英國航空一架波音787-10夢幻客機17日上午在倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）滑行時衝出滑行道。該機執飛前往奈及利亞拉各斯的BA75航班，約上午10時30分由5號航站C衛星樓登機門後推，前往27L跑道途中錯過轉彎而受困。據航班追蹤資料，飛機於當地時間上午10時45分左右未能完成預定轉彎，以約5節（每小時9.3公里）的速度滑行時，前輪陷入泥地，停在27L跑道西端、5B與5C衛星樓之間的草地上，數小時後仍受困於原地。事故原因目前仍不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: British Airways Boeing 787-10 veers off taxiway at Heathrow, stuck in mud
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A British Airways Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner has suffered a taxiway excursion at London Heathrow Airport (LHR). The widebody twinjet had pushed back from its gate at the airport's satellite Terminal 5C and was on its way to runway 27L ahead of its planned departure to Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS) in Lagos, Nigeria, as BA75. However, it missed a turn and got stuck. Several hours later, the aircraft remained beached in the grass at the western end of runway 27L between satellite terminals 5B and 5C. British Airways has confirmed that it is working to get the passengers of flight BA75 on their way again, but the return leg has been canceled as a result of the excursion.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 俄軍機穿越臺灣防空識別區 國防部譴責衝擊區域穩定
taiwan_aviation.summary: 針對俄羅斯軍機11月17日航經臺灣東部空域，副參謀總長執行官黃志偉上將18日表示，俄軍機清晨穿越臺灣防空識別區，國軍依相關規定，運用聯合情監偵手段掌握並適切應處。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan condemns Russian military aircraft activity after ADIZ transit
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s defence ministry said Russian military aircraft crossed its air defence identification zone early on November 17. Speaking on November 18, General Huang Chih-wei said the armed forces used joint intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities to monitor the activity and respond under established procedures.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣虎航故宮彩繪機預計11月19日首航 飛往日本福岡
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺灣虎航表示，與國立故宮博物院合作的「國寶出遊去」聯名彩繪機，預計11月19日首航飛往日本福岡。雙方9月底攜手，將10件國寶級文物與畫作融入機身設計。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Tigerair Taiwan's museum-themed aircraft set for first flight to Fukuoka on Nov. 19
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Tigerair Taiwan says its National Palace Museum-themed aircraft is scheduled to make its first flight in the new livery to Fukuoka, Japan, on Nov. 19. The partners teamed up in late September and based the livery on 10 cultural objects and paintings.

international_aviation.headline: ICAO 蒙特婁總部推出航安展覽 聚焦零死亡長期目標
international_aviation.summary: 國際民航組織（ICAO）11月17日宣佈，在加拿大蒙特婁總部博物館推出新的航空安全展覽。展期一年，由空中巴士贊助，透過互動展示及實例，說明航空安全如何受惠於國際合作、科技與共同標準。
international_aviation.headline_en: ICAO opens Montreal aviation safety exhibition focused on zero-fatality vision
international_aviation.summary_en: ICAO announced a new aviation safety exhibition at the museum in its Montreal headquarters on November 17. Sponsored by Airbus, the year-long display uses interactive exhibits and practical examples to explain the role of international cooperation, technology and effective safety standards.

international_aviation.headline: 美國議員就民用航空器交通資訊接收設備達原則協議 軍機要求未定
international_aviation.summary: 美國議員於2026年11月17日達成原則協議，擬要求現已受ADS-B Out規範的民用航空器配備交通資訊接收設備。軍用航空器的設備要求仍未談定。
international_aviation.headline_en: US lawmakers agree in principle on aircraft traffic receivers; military requirements unresolved
international_aviation.summary_en: US lawmakers reached an agreement in principle on November 17, 2026, to require traffic-awareness equipment on civilian aircraft already subject to ADS-B Out rules. Requirements for military aircraft remain unresolved.

international_aviation.headline: 德國 AeroForce X 偵察機完成首飛 無人飛行測試時程未定
international_aviation.summary: 德國 Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 偵察機原型機11月14日在布蘭登堡邦施特勞斯貝格機場完成首飛，開始飛行測試。此次由飛行員在機上操作；公司表示，操控、穩定性及關鍵系統測試均達成目標。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aerodata AeroForce X completes piloted maiden flight; unmanned test date unannounced
international_aviation.summary_en: Germany’s Aerodata completed the maiden flight of its AeroForce X prototype at Strausberg Airport in Brandenburg on November 14. A pilot was on board. The company said tests of handling, stability and key systems met their objectives.
